root.title: gamble-core routine configuration
root.description: GENERATED from config/knobs.json by tools/gen_config.py. Field names are the environment variable names entrypoint.sh reads.  FULL variant: every knob. The lean one is usually what you want.

TASK.title: Workflow / Task
TASK.description: Workflow / Task -- Which workflow to run. A default set here is NOT enough: the platform must pass the value into the container, as a command argument or in the environment. The run log names the source it arrived from.

PROFILE.title: Profile
PROFILE.description: Profile -- A named settings file in config/profiles/. Individual fields below still override it. Recorded in the manifest, so a run is reproducible from its profile name.

NITER.title: Iterations (sweeps)  [count, flat, nested, project]
NITER.description: Iterations (sweeps)  [count, flat, nested, project] -- Total MCMC sweeps.

NBURN.title: Burn-in sweeps  [flat]
NBURN.description: Burn-in sweeps  [flat] -- Burn-in sweeps; must be < NITER. Empty keeps the driver default.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)

THIN.title: Thinning  [flat]
THIN.description: Thinning  [flat] -- Store every k-th retained draw.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)

N_CHAINS.title: Chains  [count, flat, nested]
N_CHAINS.description: Chains  [count, flat, nested] -- Chains fitted in parallel; Rhat needs at least 2.

SUBSAMPLE.title: Pixel subsample  [nested]
SUBSAMPLE.description: Pixel subsample  [nested] -- 0 = every pixel; otherwise cap the pixel count.

CLASSIFICATION.title: Classification [model spec]  [flat, nested]
CLASSIFICATION.description: Classification [model spec]  [flat, nested] -- Class column(s) the model predicts -- decides what the outcome IS.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

RE_GROUP.title: RE grouping [model spec]  [flat]
RE_GROUP.description: RE grouping [model spec]  [flat] -- Grouping the random effects are keyed on.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

RE_VARS.title: RE covariates [model spec]  [flat]
RE_VARS.description: RE covariates [model spec]  [flat] -- Covariates carrying a random effect. Empty = intercept only (the standard; measured to converge better than random slopes). 'all' = every linear covariate; or a comma-separated list.  (default = leave it to the driver's own default)  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

RE_BLOCK.title: RE block [model spec]  [nested]
RE_BLOCK.description: RE block [model spec]  [nested] -- Nested-path RE block. intercept is the documented standard.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

VARIANT.title: Nested variant [model spec]  [nested]
VARIANT.description: Nested variant [model spec]  [nested] -- factorized = independent nests; iv = inclusive-value coupling.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

SYMMETRIC_HS.title: Symmetric horseshoe [model spec]  [nested]
SYMMETRIC_HS.description: Symmetric horseshoe [model spec]  [nested] -- Symmetric (zero-sum) horseshoe. TRUE is the standard; the job verifies the sampler carries the fix before fitting.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

USE_BART.title: BART [model spec]  [flat]
USE_BART.description: BART [model spec]  [flat] -- Terrain (and whatever BART_COLS names) enters as a tree ensemble instead of linear terms. FLAT PATH ONLY -- nested_cut has no BART support.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

BART_COLS.title: BART covariate blocks [model spec]  [flat]
BART_COLS.description: BART covariate blocks [model spec]  [flat] -- Which covariates BART takes. Named blocks, combinable with '+': topo, climate, soil, socio, yield (e.g. 'topo' or 'topo+climate'). Empty = every non-focal column; or give an explicit comma-separated column list. Terrain needs ADD_COORDS=TRUE to include lon/lat.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

NTREES_BART.title: BART trees [model spec]  [flat]
NTREES_BART.description: BART trees [model spec]  [flat] -- Trees per class in the ensemble.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

BART_K_PREV.title: BART prevalence-scaled shrinkage [model spec]  [flat]
BART_K_PREV.description: BART prevalence-scaled shrinkage [model spec]  [flat] -- Prevalence-scaled leaf shrinkage. Measured super-additive with symmetric BART (+75.4 held-out together vs +38.4 symmetric alone); FALSE restores flat k.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

ADD_COORDS.title: Add lon/lat covariates [model spec]  [flat]
ADD_COORDS.description: Add lon/lat covariates [model spec]  [flat] -- Add lon/lat as design columns. REQUIRED for BART_COLS=topo to cover coordinates -- without it 'topo' silently resolves to the 4 terrain columns.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

COORD_TYPE.title: Coordinate type [model spec]  [flat]
COORD_TYPE.description: Coordinate type [model spec]  [flat] -- lonlat = EPSG:4326 degrees (readable); laea = native EPSG:3035 metres.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

MUNDLAK.title: Mundlak group means [model spec]  [flat]
MUNDLAK.description: Mundlak group means [model spec]  [flat] -- Group-mean predictors for the RE prior mean. An interpretation fix (removes FE-RE correlation), not an accuracy one.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

PROMOTE_NATURAL_OTHER.title: Promote Natural_other [model spec]  [flat]
PROMOTE_NATURAL_OTHER.description: Promote Natural_other [model spec]  [flat] -- Move Natural_other out of the non-choosable residual.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

N_CORES.title: Cores  [count, flat, nested]
N_CORES.description: Cores  [count, flat, nested] -- Worker processes. Empty follows N_CHAINS; more cores than chains does not help.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)

M.title: Imputations (M) [model spec]  [nested]
M.description: Imputations (M) [model spec]  [nested] -- Multiple-imputation draws of the inclusive value. Only reaches the model when VARIANT=iv; with factorized nests there is no inclusive value to impute.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

BM_NITER.title: Project fit iterations  [project]
BM_NITER.description: Project fit iterations  [project] -- Sweeps for a project fit. Empty falls back to NITER, then to the project script's own 5000.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)

PIXEL_RES.title: Grid resolution (km) [model spec]  [flat]
PIXEL_RES.description: Grid resolution (km) [model spec]  [flat] -- Grid resolution in km. 10 km is ~48-64k pixels over the EU, 5 km ~180k -- roughly four times the data and the runtime.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

PIXEL_INTERSECT.title: Cell intersection [model spec]  [flat]
PIXEL_INTERSECT.description: Cell intersection [model spec]  [flat] -- Split each grid cell where it crosses this boundary, so a cell spanning two regions becomes two observations. NULL = native grid cells, no split. Changes the UNIT OF OBSERVATION, not just the labelling.  CHANGES WHAT IS ESTIMATED -- runs differing here are not comparable with runs at the default.

DESIGN_PATH.title: Design dump path
DESIGN_PATH.description: Design dump path -- Path to a pixel_model_inputs*.rds. 'auto' detects one on the drive or /data and logs what it searched; set a path to remove all ambiguity.

PROJECT.title: Project (design selection)
PROJECT.description: Project (design selection) -- Chooses between staged design dumps for the generic tasks (nested, flat_*). Project tasks carry their own project, so 'auto' is right for them.

GAMBLE_WORK_DIR.title: Mounted drive
GAMBLE_WORK_DIR.description: Mounted drive -- The FUSE mount results are collected from. output/ and results/ are symlinked here before the run.

GAMBLE_MASTER_PARQUET.title: Master 1 km parquet
GAMBLE_MASTER_PARQUET.description: Master 1 km parquet -- Covariate parquet, needed by a *_design task and irrelevant to a fit. 'auto' looks under /data.

GAMBLE_CASCADE_DATA.title: Cascade data directory
GAMBLE_CASCADE_DATA.description: Cascade data directory -- cascadinggamble-core/data. 'auto' looks under /data.

EXTRA.title: Overrides
EXTRA.description: Overrides -- one-off settings as KEY=VALUE, comma separated, e.g. 'NITER=8000, USE_BART=TRUE'. Applied on top of the profile, and rejected if a key is not a declared knob. 'none' for no overrides.
